• Evaluate the performance, robustness, and reliability of AI models and systems through rigorous testing and validation procedures, ensuring alignment with project requirements and objectives.

General:

• Create and maintain technical documentation, including design specifications, implementation details, and best practices, to facilitate knowledge sharing and collaboration.
• Maintain a high level of quality and implement rigorous testing and validation processes to ensure the reliability, robustness, and performance of systems in real-world environments.

• Proficient in multiple programming languages including, but not limited to, Python, Go, Rust, Java, C, C++, SQL, TensorFlow
